versions.name: Camp Raymond

features.note: All meals are served in the Camp Raymond dining hall, called the Bistro.
Trail hikes ranging from two to twelve miles.
A lake used for canoeing and fishing.

versions.summary: Grand Canyon Council's Camp Raymond, a Cub Scout resident camp near Parks and Flagstaff, Arizona.

sources.citation: Identity correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by camp staff 2026-08-31 (submission DqaG0Nl), kept anonymous at submitter request. Grand Canyon Council runs two distinct Arizona properties: Camp Raymond (this record; 7709 S Boy Scout Camp Road, Parks, near Flagstaff) and R-C Scout Ranch (19887 E AZ Hwy 260, Payson). The camp-finder import mislabeled this Parks property as 'R-C Scout Ranch'; corroborated by area4history (separate R-C and Raymond entries) and this property's own Cub Raymond registration and Bistro dining hall. The address, coordinates, elevation, website, and features already described Camp Raymond and are unchanged; only id, name, and summary were corrected.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder (as the mislabeled 'az-r-c-scout-ranch'), then split out to this correct id on 2026-09-10 after a camp-staff correction resolved the long-standing identity defect. The Parks/Flagstaff property the import located, priced, and surveyed is Camp Raymond, not R-C Scout Ranch (a separate Payson property, now its own az-r-c-scout-ranch record). verified_at is the correction date; imported_at is the original ingest. The evergreen summary excludes dates/fees/schedules. Features surveyed 2026-07-26 against the council's adventure camp guide (guide tier) describe this property and are carried over unchanged.
